name: GoCodebook API
description:
Search California local ordinances (city and county codes) and get structured results with verbatim excerpts, citations and links.

**Free sample** — no key, rate-limited per address, no AI overview.

**Paid access** — send an API key (`Authorization: Bearer gcb_live_…`). $0.30 a search with the AI overview included, drawn from a prepaid balance; a search with no results is not charged. `gcb_test_…` keys are free and rate-limited. Pricing, keys and limits: https://gocodebook.com/developers

Requests, including query text, are stored. Results are code text, not legal advice.
